traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md defines two main behaviors: (1) inserting a file-level @supports template with clear placeholders when missing, and (2) auto-fixing malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes in test names while preserving semantics and not inferring new IDs. The require-test-traceability rule and its helpers implement both behaviors with configuration flags (autoFixTestTemplate, autoFixTestPrefixFormat, testSupportsTemplate). Tests in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts explicitly cover all listed requirements (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE), including both before/after fixes and ensuring no auto-fix is applied where semantic inference would be required. User documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md documents the auto-fix capabilities and configuration in line with the story. All acceptance criteria and requirements are satisfied with concrete implementation and passing tests, so this story is PASSED.
